component_families.note: Every left-side 讠 becomes 言. The single biggest family: almost all speech-related characters.
Left-side 钅 always becomes 金. Metals, money, tools.
Left-side 饣 becomes the 食 radical (written compressed, 飠). Food and eating.
Left-side 纟 becomes 糸. Silk, thread, connection, also many abstract words (經, 給, 結).
门 becomes 門 both alone and as an enclosure. Trap: 闹 becomes 鬧 (with 鬥, not 門).
贝 becomes 貝 anywhere in the character. Money and value words.
见 becomes 見 as a whole or as a component. Seeing, perceiving.
车 becomes 車 wherever it appears. Vehicles and many common words (比較, 輸贏, 連續).
马 becomes 馬 with its four dots. Also the phonetic in 嗎/媽/罵.
鸟 becomes 鳥. Note 岛→島: the bird's feet are replaced by 山.
鱼 becomes 魚 with four dots at the bottom.
页 becomes 頁 on the right side. Head- and page-related words, plus 題, 順, 顧.
长 becomes 長. Taiwan writes accounts as 帳 (帳單, 帳戶) rather than 賬.
东 becomes 東 as a whole and as a component (陳 is a very common surname).
韦 becomes 韋. 偉大, 周圍, 違反, 韓國.
风 becomes 風 with 虫 inside. 颱風 also needs 颱.
仑 becomes 侖 (人 roof over 冊). 討論, 輪流, 倫理.
区 (with 㐅 inside) becomes 區 (three 口). 地區, 歐洲.
龙 becomes 龍. 寵物, 籠子, 龐大.
尧 becomes 堯 (three 土 on top). 發燒, 知曉, 燒烤.
戋 becomes 戔 (two 戈 stacked).
专 becomes 專. 傳統, 轉乘, 專心.
会 becomes 會. 開會, 繪畫.
单 becomes 單 (two 口 on top). Trap: 战 is 戰, also from 單.
Trap: 兰 alone is 蘭, but inside 拦/栏/烂 it stands for 闌 (門 + 柬).
两 becomes 兩 (two 入 inside).
卢 (and the 户 in 驴/炉) stand for 盧. 火爐, 蘆筍.
罗 becomes 羅 (罒 over 維). 蘿蔔, 邏輯.
买→買, 卖→賣; the right side of 读/续 also becomes 賣-shaped. 讀書, 繼續.
The 亦-like top stands for 䜌 (言 flanked by two 糸). 台灣 is written with 灣.
监 becomes 監. 藍色, 籃球.
当 becomes 當. 當然, 檔案.
The simplified 'three dots + cover' top here stands for two 火 over 冖. 營養, 光榮, 勞工.
Same-looking simplified top, different traditional source: 學 and 覺 have the complex 𦥯 top. Learn 營 and 學 tops as two families.
The two-stroke + 又 component stands for 臤 (臣 + 又).
只 on the right of 识/职/织 stands for 戠. Trap: 只 alone is 只 or 隻, not 戠.
The simplified right side stands for 昜 (日 over 一 and 勿).
呙 becomes 咼. 火鍋, 車禍.
佥 becomes 僉 (two 口 and two 人 under a roof). 檢查, 危險, 經驗.
将 becomes 將 (爿 on the left). 醬油, 獎金.
齐 becomes 齊. 經濟, 擁擠.
丽 becomes 麗 (鹿 underneath). 美麗.
冈 becomes 岡. 剛剛, 鋼琴.
夹 becomes 夾 (大 with two 人). 夾子, 海峽.
仓 becomes 倉. 創造, 搶劫, 蒼蠅.
亚 becomes 亞. 亞洲, 惡劣 (but 噁心 for 'disgusting').
Inside other characters 发 is always 發 (never 髮). 撥電話, 廢話. Alone it is a one-to-many trap: 發/髮.

component_families.simplified: 广 (only when it means 廣)
component_families.note: Trap: 广 as a radical in 店, 床, 底, 康 is unchanged; only where it abbreviates 廣 does it expand (廣告, 擴大).

options.meaning: to send out, emit, happen, develop

one_to_many.tip: Hair has the 髟 'long hair' top. Everything else is 發.
Dry = 乾, do = 幹, interfere = 干. In Taiwan 幹 is also a very common swear word, and the novel uses it constantly.
If you can eat it, it has 麥 (wheat): 麵.
后 is only for royalty (and a rare surname). Time and position are always 後.
Taiwan's 里長 (borough chief) uses 里; 'inside' uses 衣-radical 裡.

options.meaning: measure word for animals and one of a pair

one_to_many.tip: Counting an animal or one item of a pair = 隻; 'only' = 只.
Restore = 復 (彳 movement), repeat/complex = 複 (衣 layers), reply/cover = 覆. In Taiwan 回覆 = reply to a message, 回復 = restore. 複習 is the common Taiwan spelling (復習 also accepted).
Relationship = 係 (人 radical). Tying = 繫 (糸 at the bottom). Department/system = 系.
Calendar has 日 (sun) underneath: 曆. Experience has 止 (feet) underneath: 歷.
Clocks and bells are struck (童 sound): 鐘. Love-at-first-sight is 一見鍾情.

options.meaning: platform, stage, Taiwan; measure word for machines

one_to_many.tip: Typhoon is always 颱 (with 風). Furniture is 檯 (with 木). For Taiwan and stages, 臺 is the formal standard and 台 the everyday form.
Water involved (氵) = 沖. Movement/force (行) = 衝.
Only the surname keeps 范.
Almost always 豐 (a full ritual vessel).
Fighting = 鬥 (two figures facing off). Taiwan's half-court basketball 鬥牛 uses 鬥.
Grain has 禾 inside: 穀.
Row a boat / good deal = 划. Taiwan seat selection is 劃位. Official Taiwan usage favours 計畫 (with 畫); 計劃 is also seen.
Only the coffee table keeps 几.
Third-tone jǐn 'as much as possible' = 儘 (with 人). Fourth-tone jìn 'exhaust' = 盡. 盡量 is also common in Taiwan.
Harvesting crops has 禾: 收穫. Winning or getting = 獲 (犭 hunting).
Money and flows = 匯 (氵 inside). Collections of words = 彙.
Signing your name = 簽. Bamboo slips, tags, temple fortunes, toothpicks = 籤.
Taiwan's convenience-store rice ball is 飯糰 (米 radical).
Loose = 鬆 (髟 hair). Taipei's 松山 is the pine 松.
Facial hair has the 髟 hair radical: 鬍.
Again, hair = 髟: 鬚.
Clouds have 雨 on top. Taiwan's 雲林縣 uses 雲.
A wristwatch is metal: 錶.
Action with the hand (扌) = 採. Appearance/spirit = 采.
Only 老闆 uses 闆 (門 + 品).
Rolling with the hand (扌) = 捲. Papers and volumes = 卷.
Making things (衣 underneath, like tailoring) = 製. Rules and systems = 制. School uniform is 制服.

options.meaning: to go on an expedition, conquer

one_to_many.tip: Recruiting and signs = 徵 (with 王 in the middle). Military marches = 征.
Fine texture (糸 silk) = 緻.
Leftovers = 餘 (食 radical). Only the surname keeps 余.
鬱 is a famous hard character; learn it whole. Rich aroma (濃郁) keeps 郁.
Clothing hem has 衣: 襬.
Permission = 准 (2 strokes of ice). Accuracy/preparation = 準 (氵 + 隼 + 十). Note the exam admission ticket is 准考證.
Letting go uses the hand (扌): 捨不得. Dormitory = 宿舍.
Taiwan writes 'disgusting' as 噁心 with 口.
In Traditional the preposition is always 於 (方 + 仒). 于 survives only as a surname, so 终于 becomes 終於.
Organs are body parts (月/肉): 臟. Dirty has 骨: 髒. 髒話 = swear words.
Ginger is a plant (艹): 薑. Taiwan's winter dish 薑母鴨 uses it.
Measure word for dramas = 齣 (齒 radical).
Excuses and 'by means of' = 藉 (艹). Borrowing = 借.
Taiwan generally writes weeks with 週 (辶). 周末 is also seen; 周 alone for surroundings and the surname.
Winding or circling motion = 迴 (辶). Taiwan's conveyor-belt sushi is 迴轉壽司.
On land (辶) = 遊; in water (氵) = 游. The EasyCard is 悠遊卡.
Wind blowing = 颳 (風 radical). Taiwan's scratch-card lottery is 刮刮樂.
Salty has 鹵 (salt): 鹹. Taiwanese food: 鹹酥雞, 鹹粥.
Taiwan tends to write 'fierce (person)' as 兇 and 'bad omen' as 凶; 兇手 and 凶手 are both seen.
Feeding involves food (食 radical): 餵.
MOE treats 嚐 as a variant of 嘗, but Taiwan commonly writes 'taste' as 嚐 (with 口) and 'try' as 嘗試.
Bonus trap: 'unlucky' is usually written 倒楣 in Taiwan, not 倒霉.
Folding clothes or paper = 摺 (扌 + 習). Discounts = 打折.

options.meaning: to hold up with the palm, support

one_to_many.tip: Requests with words (言) = 託: 拜託 is everywhere in Taiwan. Checked luggage is 託運.
Written records have 言: 誌. Taiwan says 志工 for volunteer and 填志願 for listing university choices.
Merging = 併 (人 radical). 'Moreover/not at all' = 並.
Question words always use 麼. The youngest sibling is 老么.
Only yearning (嚮往) and guides (嚮導) use 嚮.

taiwan_variants.note: Both are correct. 臺 is the MOE standard form and appears in official names (臺北市政府, 國立臺灣大學); 台 is used everywhere in daily life, signs and media.
Taiwan writes 裡 (衣 on the left). 裏 is the form preferred in Hong Kong and older print.
Taiwan uses 著 for zhe, zháo, zhuó and zhù (看著, 睡著, 穿著, 著名). 着 looks simplified/Japanese and is not standard in Taiwan.
線 is standard in Taiwan; 綫 is a Hong Kong/older variant.
群 (left-right) is standard; 羣 (top-bottom) appears in older or Hong Kong texts.
Taiwan prints 為 (four dots). 爲 is common in Hong Kong and in some fonts.
峰 (left-right) is standard; 峯 (top-bottom) is a variant.
Both appear in Taiwan (嘆氣, 讚歎/讚嘆); 嘆 is more common in everyday writing. Treat both as correct.
汙 is the MOE standard (汙染 in textbooks); 污 is a very common variant, seen even on government signage.
床 is standard everywhere in Taiwan; 牀 is archaic/Hong Kong.
Taiwan writes 眾 (目 on top); 衆 (血 on top) is Hong Kong/older print.
衛 is the Taiwan form (衛生紙); 衞 is used in Hong Kong.
Taiwan writes 啟 (攵 on the right, 戶 top-left); 啓 is the Hong Kong/Japanese-style form.
MOE standard is 祕 (示 radical) in 祕密, 祕書; 秘 (禾 radical) is extremely common in everyday writing.
豔 is the MOE standard; 艷 is a widespread variant (驚艷/驚豔).
Always 證 in Taiwan (身分證, 證明). 証 is a different classical character sometimes used as a handwritten shortcut; avoid it.
Taiwan distinguishes 菸 for tobacco (香菸, 抽菸, 禁菸) from 煙 for smoke (煙火, 煙霧). Laws and signs use 菸.
Taiwan writes 痕跡, 足跡 with 跡 but 古蹟, 奇蹟, 事蹟 with 蹟. 迹 is a variant.
鉤 is standard (掛鉤, 鉤子); 鈎 is a variant.
Taiwan uses 麵 (麥 + 面); 麪 is a variant.
雞 (隹 on the right) is standard; 鷄 (鳥 on the right) is a variant.
Taiwan writes 才 for both 'talent' and 'only then'; 纔 is archaic.

taiwan_variants.form: 戶 / 溫 / 內 / 說 / 吳
taiwan_variants.alt: 户 / 温 / 内 / 説 / 吴
taiwan_variants.moe_preferred: 戶, 溫, 內, 說, 吳
taiwan_variants.note: Glyph-shape differences: Taiwan's standard fonts write 戶 with a slanted first stroke, 溫 with 囚, 內 with 入, 說 with 八-topped 兌, 吳 with 口 over 夨. These are the same characters drawn differently; your keyboard font may show either.
